retrievalProfile.description: A high-intensity, monochromatic extreme close-up of a face capturing raw emotion with bold sans-serif typography overlaying the top edge.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white soul album style

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic, high-contrast extreme close-up of a male face, cropped tightly to focus on the eyes, nose, and open mouth. The expression is intense and emotive. Bold, condensed sans-serif typography is positioned at the very top, partially overlapping the forehead.
coreVisualRelationships: The open mouth and teeth act as a bright focal point against the dark skin tones.
The typography is anchored to the top horizontal edge, creating a frame for the face.
The tight crop eliminates the background, forcing an intimate confrontation with the subject.
The lighting emphasizes the texture of the skin and the contours of the facial expression.
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up framing that cuts off the top of the head and chin.
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows and bright highlights on teeth/eyes.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 100% of the frame, centered horizontally, with the nose and mouth as the primary vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open mouth and visible teeth provide the strongest point of contrast and visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold text at the top, down the bridge of the nose to the expressive mouth.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject fills the entire canvas, creating a sense of claustrophobia and intensity.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks for shadows and facial hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for typography and teeth highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the dark skin and the bright white elements.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly italicized or slanted for the primary line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a tall, condensed sans-serif and a short, wide slab-serif.

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, condensed, high-impact feel of the primary text.
Matches the wide, heavy slab-serif secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic, high-contrast extreme close-up of a face with an intense expression (open mouth, closed eyes). Ensure the crop is tight, cutting off the top of the head and chin, with the face filling the entire square frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, white, condensed sans-serif uppercase text at the very top edge, overlapping the forehead. Place a smaller, wider slab-serif line of text directly beneath it.

verificationChecks: Is the crop tight enough to remove the background entirely?
Is the text white and positioned at the top edge?

adjustableVariables: Amount of text overlap on the forehead
mustRedesign: Avoid any color; must be grayscale.
Avoid showing the neck or background; must be an extreme close-up.

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on skin texture and teeth
Strong tonal separation between shadows and highlights
avoid: Centered text that obscures the eyes

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast in the mouth area.
Ensure the text is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the crop cuts through the forehead and chin.
Confirm the absence of any color tint.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme Close-Up + Monochromatic High Contrast + Top-Aligned Bold Condensed Sans-Serif
